# spikes/s1a/scripts/Get-SpikeEstimate.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Prices the spike's Azure lines from the retail prices API and prints the amount and note for the spend guard's open command (spend/spend_guard.py).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-Region` | string | no | `'eastus2'` |  |
| `-Hours` | double | no | `6` |  |
| `-TokenUpperBound` | double | no | `13.00` |  |
| `-Agents` | int | no | `3` | One hosted agent per model the Hosts agent is compared on (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku). |
| `-Provider` | string | no | `'Foundry'` | Anthropic: the fallback. No hosted agents; one more Container App (the agents), and tokens billed by Anthropic. |
